name: ActiveSpeakerView

module.name: ActiveSpeakerView
module.description: Shows one participant: participantState.activeVideoUser from useZoomUIToolkit. Resizes to fit its container. Empty until that participant is set or while the session isn't connected.

props.name: tileAspectRatio
props.description: Width-to-height ratio for the video tile.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the view with display: none while keeping it mounted.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the root container.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the root container. backgroundColor and color also apply to the video tile.

notes: Fills its parent (100% width and height), so give the parent a size.
The tile is centered and keeps tileAspectRatio. When the participant's video is off, the tile shows their name.
